hero.title: Wealth Management for Individuals & Families
hero.subtitle: Independent, fiduciary advice built around your entire financial life.

blocks.text: PointOak provides personalized wealth management, investment management, and comprehensive financial planning designed to bring decisions together into one coordinated strategy.

sections.title: A Relationship Built Around Your Interests

blocks.text: As an SEC-registered investment adviser, PointOak serves its advisory clients as a fiduciary. We are required to act in our clients' best interests and put their interests ahead of our own.

Investment decisions do not happen in isolation. Retirement, taxes, workplace benefits, Social Security, pensions, estate considerations, family priorities, and major life events can all influence how your wealth should be managed. Our role is to help connect those decisions into one coordinated strategy.

Your 401(k) may be one of your largest financial assets. Understand your options before you move it. PointOak's experience with both employer-sponsored retirement plans and private wealth management provides perspective on the decisions that can arise when retirement assets transition from the workplace into your broader financial life.

items.title: Broader access can create more ways to build a portfolio.

body.text: For appropriate clients, PointOak may evaluate private credit, private equity, real assets, real estate, hedge fund strategies, structured investments, and other alternative or private-market strategies alongside traditional investments. These investments can involve limited liquidity, longer holding periods, valuation complexity, higher fees, leverage, and eligibility requirements, and they are not appropriate for every client or portfolio.

sections.title: A Boutique Relationship Without a Narrow Perspective

blocks.text: PointOak combines direct access to experienced advisers with broad investment and planning capabilities. When appropriate, we also coordinate with a client’s CPA, estate attorney, and other professionals so important decisions are considered together.

body.text: Learn what matters to you and how the pieces of your financial life fit together.
Build a coordinated investment and planning strategy.
Review progress and adjust as circumstances, markets, tax rules, and goals change.
